name: ai-based-steganography
description: StegoDetect AI - Multimedia Steganography Detection Desktop Application

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "cross-env NODE_ENV=development vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.build:exe: vite build && electron-builder --win --config.directories.output="%TEMP%\stegodetect-build" && node -e "const fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'), temp=path.join(process.env.TEMP, 'stegodetect-build'), dest='dist-installer'; if(!fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.mkdirSync(dest, {recursive:true}); fs.readdirSync(temp).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.exe')).forEach(f=>{ fs.copyFileSync(path.join(temp,f), path.join(dest,f)); console.log('Copied:', f); }); console.log('All .exe files are ready in dist-installer/');"
